svg.title: Level 1 static routing in practice
svg.desc: Manifests, a registry, and a profile compile into a small prompt-visible set of domain routers. For each request, deterministic exact aliases and keyword rules select one off-prompt leaf skill. The runtime inspects and activates that exact skill, then loads a named resource only when its condition is met. Ambiguous requests stop for clarification.
